coordinate_convention.name: ras_yup
coordinate_convention.description: glTF = (x, z, -y) of NIfTI RAS mm, minus centre_offset_gltf_mm; +X patient right, +Y superior, +Z posterior (Y-up, right-handed, never mirrored)
coordinate_convention.to_ras: RAS = (X + ox, -(Z + oz), Y + oy) where (ox,oy,oz) = centre_offset_gltf_mm

mesh_method:
Smooth meshes + GLB following the viewer asset contract (out/viewer_assets/build_viewer_assets.py; imported read-only).
Mesh pipeline per structure: crop -> signed distance field (mm) -> cubic resample to 0.5 mm isotropic -> Gaussian
anti-aliasing (0.5 mm) -> marching cubes (level 0) -> windowed-sinc smoothing (VTK) -> isotropic explicit remeshing
(pymeshlab) -> small normal-offset volume correction to the mask volume -> glTF coords (x, z, -y) of RAS mm minus
centre_offset_gltf_mm (Y-up).
